Keel runs a project's checks after every agent turn before anything is committed. If you pressed Stop while those checks were running, nothing happened. The checks kept going and the button just sat there. The cause was small. The code that runs the checks was handed cancel hooks that were placeholders. They never looked at whether you had pressed Stop. So Stop returned false, and the checks ran to the end every time. Every test passed, because no test pressed Stop in the middle of a check. The fix in Keel 0.4.71: Stop now marks the turn's checks as stopped, the gate ends them, and nothing is committed. We also gave the checks a ceiling. # Oya Browser

Oya Browser is a HIPAA-compliant browser for healthcare and regulated work: an AI browser on your desktop, and an agentic browser your agents run in the cloud or self-hosted, with every action on a tamper-evident audit trail.
